messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester in Wireless Communication, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

建議主軸：目前 Raw 證據最強的是先推 **CMX500 signaling tester for Wi‑Fi 7 R&D**，再推 **CMP180 non-signaling tester for Wi‑Fi 7/beyond-Wi‑Fi‑7 R&D and production** [26]。
### 推薦先賣
Raw passage 直接說 R&S 將在 MWC 2024 展示 CMX500 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，且新增 Wi‑Fi 7 testing capabilities [26]。
Raw passage 也說 CMX500 one-box tester 可讓 wireless device R&D engineers 用單一儀器完整測試 latest-generation cellular and non-cellular standards operation [26]。
Raw passage 直接說 R&S CMP180 radio communication tester 會以 loopback mode 驗證 480 MHz bandwidth signal waveform [26]。
Raw passage 也把 CMP180 定位為 future-proof solution for users in R&D and production, even beyond Wi‑Fi 7 requirements [26]。
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Wi‑Fi 7 wireless device R&D signaling test | 新增 Wi‑Fi 7 testing capabilities；multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；one-box tester | 可用 single instrument setup 測試 latest-generation cellular and non-cellular standards operation | [26] | Raw passage 未標示 option code、software version、硬體 BOM 或價格。[26] |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wi‑Fi 7 chipset / device R&D signaling validation | CMX500 | 強調 newly added Wi‑Fi 7 testing capabilities 與 single instrument setup for cellular and non-cellular standards | option code、正式支援矩陣、版本與報價未由 Raw passage 提供。[26] |
| Beyond-Wi‑Fi‑7 early R&D positioning | CMP180 | 強調 480 MHz bandwidth waveform 與 beyond Wi‑Fi 7 requirements 的 future-proof message | beyond-Wi‑Fi‑7 標準、正式波形、option code 與商用可得性未由 Raw passage 提供。[26] |
### 限制
目前 Raw evidence 只直接支撐 CMX500 的 Wi‑Fi 7 signaling R&D opportunity 與 CMP180 的 480 MHz waveform / R&D and production opportunity [26]。
目前 Raw evidence 只提供 CMX500 NTN 相關資訊頁連結，未直接描述 NTN testing capability 或商機內容 [25][27]。

來源：
[25] `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite.md`
[26] `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`
[27] `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026.md`
